structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of 11 or more clones called 'New guy is chill' (NEWGUY) launched within about 15 minutes. It started on a Meteora virtual curve, was created and migrated at the same moment, and trades on a pumpswap pair. It is about 14 minutes old, at around $135k market cap with $35k liquidity. It has done about $537k in volume, and 5-minute volume is running 5x the 1-hour rate. The leading clone (2drAsp…) is much bigger: $877k market cap, $73k liquidity and $1.1M in 1-hour volume. This coin peaked near $197k and is now about $135k, down from $159k when it was detected.

narrative.description: 'New guy is chill' appears to be a meme from TikTok/X. The packet links a TikTok search and an X status from FirstCoinLaunch. Many clones launched at once to chase it.
narrative.why_spreading: Many deployers raced to launch the same name within minutes. That usually follows a viral post. The leader's $1.1M in 1-hour volume shows real attention on the theme.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the second-highest liquidity of the clones, which points to a secondary copy catching spillover buying.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 2drAspMdBZQbm5YnrCWsX4gQPkwqrL4NxYZVr236BdP9 was created about 138s earlier and is at $877k market cap with $73k liquidity. It is the clear leader. At least 10 other same-name clones exist, most of them already dead.

authenticity.evidence: There were 2008 unique buyers against 149 unique sellers, a one-sided pattern that points to bots or bundled buying. GMGN tags 105 wallets as bundlers. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets and no paid boosts. The demand looks like clone-war spillover from the leader token.
authenticity.uncertainty: RugCheck shows one unlabeled wallet holding 80%, while GMGN shows the top 10 holding only 1.9%. That wallet is probably a pool or curve account, but I can't confirm it.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked, but GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0. The two sources conflict.
One unlabeled holder has 80% of supply
The launch looks prepared: created and migrated in the same second
Price is 32% below its all-time high and fading

structured_output.counterargument: The theme clearly has attention, and the leader is near $900k. Clones with real liquidity sometimes catch buyers who missed the leader. This one has more than 2000 holders and $35k liquidity, so doubling to about $270k within 6 hours is plausible if the meme keeps growing.
unknowns: Whether the LP is actually locked or burned

structured_output.thesis: This is a secondary clone in a crowded clone war. It trails the canonical token by about 6.5x in market cap, has already come 32% off its high, shows heavy bundler activity, and the creator has exited. Most likely it fades as the flow consolidates into the leader.
